title: 5 A Day Salad
description: This nutrient-packed salad uses ten different vegetables, and each serving is equal to five cups of vegetables!
notes: The dressing is not included in the nutritional analysis. Each serving = 5 cups of vegetables (Eight 5-A-Day servings).
source: US Department of Health and Human Services Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) 5 A Day for Better Health Program

lines: 2 cups chopped green peppers (or red, yellow, or orange peppers)

steps: Wash hands with soap and water.
Wash all of the vegetables and mix them together in a large mixing bowl.
Top this colorful meal with the nonfat or low-fat dressing of your choice.
